facts.text: Deborah brings an amulet with her when she comes to reflect on her mom.

evidence.quote: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me.

facts.text: Holding the amulet brings Deborah comfort and a sense of closeness to her mom.

evidence.quote: It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.

facts.text: Deborah believes that small things like the amulet can make a big difference in connecting with people who have been lost.

evidence.quote: It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.

facts.text: Deborah also mentions that Anna has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother, which brought them closer.

evidence.quote: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
